distribution.narrative: The former China occurrence assigned to this species was a name-homonym mapping error. Huang et al. (2015) reported Polygraphus querci Yin & Huang, 1996 from Yunnan. That junior homonym was replaced by Polygraphus yunnanensis Bright, 2002 (VSN_4773), and does not refer to Polygraphus querci Wood, 1988, a synonym of P. kaimochii. No China occurrence of P. kaimochii is established from that record.

host_note: The previously linked Quercus acutissima record belongs to Polygraphus yunnanensis (VSN_4773), not to this species. No host is confirmed here.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Polygraphus kaimochii (Nobuchi, 1981).

taxonomic_history.name: Polygraphus querci
taxonomic_history.note: Published name currently treated as a synonym; original-description p. 195.

taxonomic_history.name: Polygraphus kaimochii
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Polygraphus querci Wood, 1988 (synonym of P. kaimochii) and Polygraphus querci Yin & Huang, 1996 (junior primary homonym, replaced by P. yunnanensis Bright, 2002) are different nominal species. The historical CO2015_081 association to this VSN was erroneous and has been corrected in Notion.
